purpose: Experimental workflow discovery; no production integration or readiness claim

terminology.open_loop: Jev judges frozen recorded/reconstructed state without controlling execution
terminology.closed_loop: Jev chooses an action, an executor performs it, and Jev observes the updated state
terminology.shadow: Reserved for observing an independently running live agent; not performed in this pilot

selection: Purposeful development cases: secondary finding preservation, scope of downstream claims, and potentially redundant verification. No held-out inference.

models.judging: Manual evidence audit plus executable source-extraction probes; no model judge

closedLoop.fixed_verify: One executor verification of existing findings, then finalize
closedLoop.jev_routed: Jev selects among the same allowed actions, up to two executor actions, re-evaluating updated state
closedLoop.routingThreshold: Choice confidence >= 0.6; below that manual_review. Provisional, not calibrated on these cases.
closedLoop.stopping: finalize, manual_review, model failure, two actions, or repeated identical action with identical findings/source
closedLoop.comparison: Same initial evidence, executor model/effort, available actions, and maximum action budget. Realized action and call counts differ by policy. Historical findings are shared inputs, not a control arm.

successCriteria.A-10349: Preserve both the unanchored prefix defect and slash truncation already present in the raw record; no credit for discovering a known finding
successCriteria.A-10141: Preserve the desired-vs-ready replica-count defect; qualify broader recovery claims or anchor them to inspected caller evidence
successCriteria.A-10178: Preserve both premature GC completion and shared-deadline defects; report whether further work supplies new evidence

invalidRuns: Transport failures, model mismatch, malformed outputs, or unexpected tool use are invalid, never clean passes. No outcome-based retries.
limits: Three reconstructed checkpoints from one repository, known fix-derived contracts, no clean controls, no patches, no full agent environment, and one run per arm. Not a prospective bug-detection or production-readiness study.
telemetry: THINKER_TEST=1, THINKER_TELEMETRY=off, THINKER_LOG=off, THINKER_NO_LEARN=1 inherited by children. Direct TypeSafe calls use explicit opt-in transport and a personal key, never production Thinker telemetry or hosted enrollment.
